label: For "Permit & Zoning Compliance Checking": Check building plans and applications against zoning and code rules and give applicants and officers cited findings. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Easy applications are over-represented in the data, so unusual cases fail in use.
